query_left_right_bisect: use query_left_right to find the nearest left and right timestamps around a query timestamp via bisection
lookup_timestamp_closest: use lookup_timestamp with TimeQueryOptions.CLOSEST to find the object nearest to a given timestamp
lookup_timestamp_before: use lookup_timestamp with TimeQueryOptions.BEFORE to find the most recent object before a given timestamp
lookup_timestamp_after: use lookup_timestamp with TimeQueryOptions.AFTER to find the next object after a given timestamp
review_query_left_right: review the query_left_right function to understand its bisection-based timestamp interpolation logic
